subject: Promptset acceptance lint & deadman-switch for A/B releases
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Moreno <alice@acme-health.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Promptset acceptance lint + deadman-switch proposal for Acme A/B

Hi team,

Following up from the sync this morning — Acme plans to flip A/B for their patient-summary promptset (v3) next Thursday (8/26). They asked for an explicit acceptance checklist and, critically, an automated escape path if quality or safety regressions emerge in the first 72 hours.

I put together a lightweight proposal and wanted alignment from product + evals + infra:

- Acceptance lint (pre-release checks):
  - Coverage: 200 curated prompts (50 safety edge, 100 correctness, 50 hallucination probes)
  - Thresholds: pass rate >= 95% on correctness metrics; no safety flag rate > 0.5%
  - Manual spot-check: 20 human-reviewed samples from each bucket
- Monitoring SLOs post-rollout (first 72h):
  - Rolling 1h regression trigger: >3.5% drop vs baseline on factuality score OR >0.8% increase in safety flags
  - User-visible latency/backoff: no more than 5% tail-latency increase
- Deadman-switch behavior:
  - Auto-fallback to v2 (current prod) when a hard trigger fires (as above)
  - Notify on-call and Acme via webhook + email; open an incident ticket EVALS-3421
  - Canary window: 10% traffic for first 12h then ramp to 50% if no triggers

Open questions where I need owners:
1) Who will own the lint coverage and the curated prompt list (golden set)?
2) Who sets the definitive metric implementations for "factuality" and "safety flags" (evals vs product)?
3) Who wires the automated rollback (infra + runtime) and verifies fallback correctness pre-launch?

Attachments: promptset_v3-lint-report.pdf (prelim coverage & failing samples).

Can we get signoff by EOD Tue so we can run a final dry-run Wed?

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior PM, Eval Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Moreno <alice@acme-health.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promptset acceptance lint + deadman-switch proposal for Acme A/B

Thanks Karthik — this is a good starting point. A few clarifications from product/ops perspective: 

- Owners: I'll take ownership of the golden set curation with support from Marissa (sampling/labeling ops). Aditya — can you confirm infra ownership for the auto-fallback wiring?
- Metrics: Marissa, I think evals should define the factuality metric (precise scoring), but product needs to codify user-visible thresholds. Suggest: evals implement metric + provide threshold recommendation; product signs off.
- False-positive safety flags: need a small adjudication path so we don't flip for noisy classifier blips. Proposal: require two consecutive hourly windows over trigger threshold before hard fallback; immediate soft rollback (reduce to 0% traffic from affected cohort) on single-window safety breach.

I also want an explicit QA step: a scripted replay (10k requests) run against v3 + v2 with instrumentation to confirm KV cache behavior and end-to-end fallbacks. Can the Evals team schedule the replay and share results by Wed morning?

I've attached an initial deadman_switch_playbook.md stub with the escalation flow and Slack/webhook templates.

Grace
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Aug 17, 2026 at 13:04, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Alice Moreno <alice@acme-health.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promptset acceptance lint + deadman-switch proposal for Acme A/B

Thanks — a couple quick clarifying questions from our side before you lock the golden list: 

1) For the safety adjudication path, will we get a human-in-loop lane inside the 72h window? If a safety flag is borderline, how quickly can we expect a reviewer to respond?
2) For canary cohorts: can Acme request gradual rollout by user segment (clinician vs patient) rather than random sampling? We want clinician-facing to be more conservative.

If you prefer, we can hop on a 20-minute call this afternoon. Our legal/security team will also want to see the playbook snapshot before the dry-run.

— Alice
Head of Product, Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Moreno <alice@acme-health.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promptset acceptance lint + deadman-switch proposal for Acme A/B — owners & plan

Looping back with owners and concrete next steps. Apologies for the fast turnaround.

- Owners:
  - Golden set curation: Grace + Marissa (Marissa to coordinate labeling ops)
  - Metric implementation: Evals (Marissa) to deliver scoring code + reproducible eval notebook by Tue 8/18 17:00 PT
  - Infra/fallback wiring: Aditya to own rollback automation and webhook notifications; will run smoke tests Thurs 8/20
  - On-call escalation: Prod infra on-call (pager team) with Evals as secondary contact
- Safety adjudication + HIL: We will provide a 2-person HIL queue (Redwood reviewers) with 2-hour SLA for triage during the first 72h. If Acme wants clinician-only segmentation, we can implement cohort-level rollout — logged as EVALS-3421-SEG.
- Canary cadence: Start 10% clinician-excluded traffic for 12h, expand to 30% (clinician cohort at 5%) if no triggers, then 50% across cohorts after 24h.
- QA replay: scheduled Wed 8/19 06:00 PT (10k requests) — results to be posted to the Drive link and to EVALS-3421.

Action items:
- Karthik: finalize the golden prompt list and push the lint-report update by EOD Tue (attached: promptset_v3-lint-report.pdf)
- Aditya: confirm rollback smoke test time and provide a test run link
- Grace/Marissa: share the final playbook with Acme legal by Wed morning

I'll run the dry-run checklist and tag owners in the doc. If there are no objections, consider this the alignment and we will proceed to the dry-run Wed morning.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Evaluation Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: promptset_v3-lint-report.pdf (prelim), deadman_switch_playbook.md (stub)
